views.label: Browser to API
views.note: One nginx origin proxies exactly one API prefix by container name — the browser never makes a cross-origin request.

views.label: Behind the API
views.note: Cropwright is a pure consumer — OpenSearch, Triton, the VLM, the trainer/evaluator and the segmenter are reached only through the API.

views.label: Wire contract
views.note: The frontend's wire format is vendored from the backend's generated contract and checked by tests, not hand-copied.

cards.title: Cropwright owns no database
items: Every read/write goes through the OpenProcessor API's one prefix (default /curation)
nginx re-resolves the upstream via Docker's embedded DNS every 10s so a backend restart never pins a stale IP

cards.title: One prefix, substituted at container start
items: PUBLIC_API_PREFIX must equal the API's own OP_API_PREFIX — the API builds some URLs (region thumbnails) from its own prefix
API_UPSTREAM (default http://op-api:8000) is a Docker container name on the shared network, not a public host

cards.title: No request authentication (owner decision)
items: Every write — label, discard, export, train, ingest — is reachable by anyone who can reach the nginx origin
Deploy on a trusted LAN/VPN only, never the public internet, until the backend adds opt-in auth
